# Keres AI

> Keres AI is an AI receptionist and AI SDR platform for businesses that live on the phone. It answers every inbound call 24/7 in two rings, qualifies leads, and books appointments automatically, and runs AI-powered outbound email that lands in the inbox and books qualified meetings.

Keres AI replaces missed calls, voicemail, and slow follow-up with an always-on front desk and sales team. It is used by home-services contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, septic, towing), dental and med-spa practices, real estate teams, and professional-services firms.

Key facts:
- Answers every call within two rings, 24/7 (nights, weekends, holidays).
- Books and reschedules appointments on Google Calendar, Outlook, or field-service software.
- AI SDR runs personalized outbound email with deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, inbox warmup) built in.
- Integrations: Twilio, Google Calendar, Outlook, HubSpot, Zapier, Make, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro, FieldEdge, Service Fusion, RingCentral.
- Setup: most accounts live within five business days. Month-to-month, cancel anytime.
- Contact: ops@keresai.com
- Full reference (definitions, FAQs, descriptions): https://www.keresai.com/llms-full.txt
